item.title: Avoid Overloading Answers 🎙️ • Identify the question's core focus. • Use: “I improved X by implementing Y.” • Provide relevant, concise examples. • Stick to the STAR method—Situation, Task, Action, Result. • Pause after key points to gauge interest. 🤔 How can you make your answers more impactful and concise? #interview #communication #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
